## Description

In TaskDetailScreen, render Depends on, Blocks and the phase as one focusable link list. enter on a task opens its task detail; enter on the phase opens the phase detail; esc pops one screen. Relax the guards that stop a detail screen opening another only as far as these links need.

payload.title: Open dependencies, blocked tasks and the phase from task detail
